process.title: An introductory meeting
process.desc: An hour, at no cost. We ask what you want your money to do. You decide whether we're the right fit.

process.title: A written strategy
process.desc: Our recommendations in a Statement of Advice, with the fee to put it in place and the annual fee shown in dollars.

process.title: Advice that keeps going
process.desc: Two reviews a year, a call whenever something changes, and an annual fee you renew in writing.

faq.a: A fixed fee for the strategy and a fixed annual fee for ongoing advice, both agreed in writing. We take no commissions on investments.
Our advice tends to suit people with $750,000 or more to invest, including super. If we're not the right fit, we'll say so in the first meeting.
Your investments sit in your name on an independent platform. We can't withdraw money from your accounts.

faq.q: Will you work with my accountant?
faq.a: Yes, and with your lawyer. Most of our clients' plans need all three of us.

contactIntro: Meet us in Sydney or Melbourne, or by video wherever you are. Melbourne: Level 9, 365 Little Collins Street.
